description: Lead clinical and research programming development and application support for applications developed by my group for the Cardiovascular Program.
I had three teams under my leadership.
I had the CAS and later the EMERIS group and I project managed the effort to replace a number of legacy systems with modern C# applications.
The second group maintained professional and clinical billing for the cardiology department.
The third group developed and maintained research applications for the cardiology's research department.
Provide network, application and help desk support for the largest agency in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, The Department of Mental Retardation.

The agency is now called the Department of Developmental Services and at that time my network team of 5 managed the the entire state of Massachusetts office: 30 field office and 5 state school facilities.
We upgraded to Zen 5.0 of Novell and remotely managed our desktops.

Provided application development and support services to the Department of Youth Services. I lead the Year 2000 project to convert our Natural/Adabas mainframe system to a ASP web based application YSIS.
I also helped out as a banyan administrator to our Network Administrator.

education.institution: Suffolk University - Sawyer School of Management

matchmaking_summary: The candidate has extensive experience in managing and leading IT teams, overseeing the development and support of various applications including healthcare and research-based solutions. Their expertise spans across multiple programming languages, databases, and technologies such as Oracle SQL, C#, ASP.NET, VB.NET, SharePoint, and Microsoft SQL Server. The role requires a strong understanding of SDLC, project management, and business analysis to effectively lead projects aimed at enhancing organizational effectiveness and efficiency.
